cohort: 2591 patients under the age of 3 years who were born between April 2015 and May 2017 and were examined at the Ophthalmology Clinic of Emsey Hospital Istanbul, Turkey
finding: Babies born via cesarean section were found to have a 3.75 times higher risk of developing NLDO compared to babies born via normal spontaneous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Babies born via cesarean section were found to have a 3.75 times higher risk of developing NLDO compared to babies born via normal spontaneous vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Included babies under 3 years old; gestational age of babies born via cesarean section was lower than those born via NSVD
